input: hey! me and my partner are on a 10 day trip in thailand, staying in chaweng on koh samui, and want one special evening out on a boat this thursday, roughly 16:30 to 21:30 with pickup from our hotel. looking for something we actualy do ourselves, not just sit there watching, and dinner on the boat thats as fresh as it gets, straight from the sea. the real local thing, like what the fishermen here do, out on the water under the stars. budget around ฿4,500-8,000 for the two of us. can you book the best one?

experiences.name: Chaweng Beach Fire & Dine
experiences.description: Beachfront table for two reserved at 19:00 on Chaweng Beach, toes in the sand. Thai set menu of vegetable spring rolls, massaman curry with potato and tofu, jasmine rice and coconut ice cream, followed by the fire show at 20:30.

experiences.name: Samui Night Squid Trip – Squid Jigging & On-Board Dinner
experiences.description: Small-group evening on a traditional longtail-style fishing boat. After a sunset run out into the Gulf, the crew switches on the boat's lights and guests catch live squid on lighted jigs with pin crowns, lifting them into the air and into a seawater bucket; the crew then cuts and cooks the night's catch on board for dinner. Departs Bophut pier 17:00, back around 21:30; max 10 guests; rods, jigs and life jackets provided; Chaweng hotel transfer, drinking water and soft drinks included.

experiences.name: Wok on the Water – Sunset Thai Cooking Cruise
experiences.description: Sunset cooking cruise where you make your own Thai dinner at on-deck wok stations with a Thai chef, then eat it at anchor off Koh Samui under the stars. The guest activity is cooking at the wok stations; the cruise runs no fishing, live-animal handling or animal-contact activities. Menu: tom yum with mushrooms, pad krapow with tofu and mango sticky rice, herbs and vegetables from a Nathon market supplier. Departs Bophut pier 17:00, returns about 21:30; max 14 guests; aprons, recipe cards and Chaweng hotel transfer included.

experiences.name: Lamai Garden Spa – Couples Massage & Dinner
experiences.description: Couples package in a quiet, lantern-lit tropical garden in Lamai: a two-hour Thai massage from 17:00 to 19:00, then dinner at 19:15 in the garden pavilion with herbal soup, stir-fried morning glory, rice and a fruit plate. Hotel transfer included.

experiences.name: Gulf Lights Catamaran – Sunset Squid Fishing & Barbecue Cruise
experiences.description: Sail by catamaran to Koh Tan for a sunset swim stop, then anchor under the deck lights for squid fishing off the stern. Guests catch live squid on lighted jigs and lift them onto deck, where they are kept in a seawater tank before the crew cuts and grills them to order at the evening barbecue. Departs Bangrak pier 16:30, returns about 21:30; max 24 guests; open bar with beer and soft drinks; hotel transfer from Chaweng included.

experiences.name: Koh Tan Sunset SUP & Supper – Paddle & Galley Dinner Cruise
experiences.description: Small catamaran trip to Koh Tan and Koh Madsum: paddleboard or kayak around the islands at dusk with an instructor, then sail back under the stars while the chef serves dinner from the galley. The guest activities are stand-up paddleboarding and kayaking; the trip runs no fishing, live-animal handling or animal-contact activities. Departs Thong Krut pier 16:30, returns about 21:30; max 12 guests; boards, kayaks and Chaweng hotel transfer included. Dinner: green curry with tofu, pad thai, som tam and mango sticky rice.

experiences.name: Overlap Stone Sunset Hike & Picnic
experiences.description: Chaweng pickup at 16:00 for a 90-minute guided trail up to the Overlap Stone viewpoint in time for sunset. Picnic basket for two with sticky rice, vegetable satay with peanut sauce, papaya salad and fresh fruit; headlamps provided for the descent.
